The Governing Council, 
Having received, in accordance with article 38 of the Provisional 
Rules for Claims Procedure ("the Rules"), the report and recommendations 
made by the panel of Commissioners concerning part one of the ninth 
instalment of individual claims for damages above USD 100,000 (category "D" 
claims), covering 220 claims, L/

as follows:

paragraph 1, and article 40, paragraph 5), information concerning the

will be provided to each respective Government or international 
organization separately.
